results.title: r/LocalLLM on Reddit: Which is the best local LLM in April 2026 for a 16 GB GPU? I'm looking for an ultimate model for some chat, light coding, and experiments with agent building.
results.snippet: Assuming you're talking 16GB GPU and you have 32GB+ system RAM, I'd go with Qwen3.5 35b. Use Q4_K_XL or 5 or 6, whatever meets your needs. Offload all layers to GPU use flash attention, q8 kv cache, offload experts to CPU until it fits.
